parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift' inside a WallpaperSampleApp directory, which is a canonical sample-app path. Per the restraint rules, any cluster where at least one record sits under an Examples/ or SampleApp/ subtree must be treated as a sample-app-mirror and no refactoring action should be taken. The DebugHUD type-alias in the DebugPanel package is a production fixture, while the one in WallpaperSampleApp is a demonstration-scoped copy; coupling them would introduce a production dependency on sample-app semantics.
